_comment: Halloween collection: 'Nightmare' forms. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. Charmander's line was requested by name (skeletal 'Bone-Rot' look, pink fire); the other 17 were picked with `generate.py pick --count 17 --seed halloween-2026` (random lines no other collection uses).

readme.title: Halloween (Nightmare)
readme.warning: CONTENT WARNING: blood, gore, rotting flesh, wounds and body horror. If you don't want it, just never use the Carved Pumpkin cosmetic.
readme.summary: Pokemon turned into nightmares, with animated textures (4 frames).
looks: darkened, bruise-purple and rot-green skin with grime, lumps, torn raw patches and crude stitches
lots of extra, misplaced, bloodshot eyes (darting, blinking, weeping blood)
mouths full of jagged bloody teeth that gnash open and shut
shiny: a pale corpse, so the blood stands out more; glowing parts turn ghost-green

specials.look: Bone-Rot: skeletons with flesh rotting off the bones, an exposed rib cage, hollow eye sockets with a pink ember, and the tail fire burning pink
